description: This file declares functions for erasing number type information in a computational graph, specifically for use in exporting models to ONNX. It includes functions to modify nodes and values within the graph to replace number types with tensor types.

methods.name: EraseNumberTypes
methods.description: Erases number type information from the entire graph, replacing NumberType outputs with DynamicType and converting constants to 0-dim tensors.

methods.name: EraseNumberTypesOnBlock
methods.description: Performs the erase operation on a specific block within the graph.
